text: Ticket S V one one four one six, on staging. Work orders whose lead technician was deleted now sit in one Tech View group, Deleted technician, with the Inactive marker and no drag grip.
Dropping a work order onto it is refused. Nothing changes.
Board View shows the same Deleted technician column.
Dragging a work order out of it works: it moves to Unassigned.
The List shows Unassigned for such a work order, the same as production today. All checks pass.
